summary: FOUND line without ": " is dropped silently; Scanned files parse errors become 0; summary "Total errors" is never read
evidence: scan.rs:37-42 drops lines without ": "; scan.rs:45-48 unwrap_or(0) for Scanned files; infected count taken from summary even when findings are empty.
failure_scenario: Output "weird FOUND" with "Infected files: 1" gives infected_files=1 and findings=[].
resolution_note: Owner sign-off 2026-11-18 (decision D7): ClamAV is not used; the engine is replaced per ADR 0004 (proposed). Finding concerns the clamscan/freshclam integration.
